name: sky-meeple-all-v1
description: ⛔ 09/09/2026: NO SUBJECT UNDER THE SHIPPED GAME. 'meepleFromBag' pays a meeple, and the commons has no meeples (C6). This arm needs a meeple control pinned beside it to mean anything. ALL FOUR balloons become random meeples. Not a shippable design - four identical balloons throw away the module's whole colour puzzle - but the arm that shows the effect at maximum size. If the Vegetable win rate does not move HERE, no partial version of the idea will move it either, and that is the question this arm exists to close. NOTE: the magenta balloon carries no `amount` in the data - 'harvest any building' is a permission and not a size - so there is no amount knob to set on it and the engine's `amount ?? 1` floor supplies the 1. That is why this arm sets a type and no number. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved.
